verdict.rationale: The evidence implies the citation metadata exists but never documents it. Search returns URLs (exa-docs-35), supports published-date filtering via startPublishedDate, which implies date metadata on results (exa-gh-9), and the answer and agent endpoints return citations (exa-gh-8, exa-docs-26). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the result schema fields (url, title, publishedDate), any guarantee that URLs are canonical, and independent or hands-on corroboration of metadata accuracy.
